loss_parameters.guidance: No new loss coefficients are introduced in this round. Only the propagation-loss experiment convention is listed as a known parameter; bend / crossing / interlayer losses are unknown and uncalibrated. No total-loss conclusion is produced.

propagation_loss.source: fslw.config experiment convention (PROPAGATION_LOSS_DB_PER_CM) as documented in README_R15 §5
propagation_loss.note: length-only experiment convention; not a measured glass value

bend_loss.note: no calibrated femtosecond-laser-written glass bend-loss function; R=15 mm is a geometry constraint only, not a measured loss value

crossing_loss.note: single-layer crossing optical feasibility not confirmed; crossing counts are geometric metrics only

interlayer_effect.note: effect of the two 3D elevation S-curves / interlayer travel on loss is not calibrated

total_loss_conclusion.reason: bend loss, crossing loss and interlayer effects are all unknown_uncalibrated; a total-loss number would require invented coefficients, therefore none is reported this round

legacy_r40_polymer_model.note: the historical polymer bend-loss estimate belongs to the R40 round and is not carried into R15 numbers

loss_parameters.note: lengths, arc counts and crossing counts are reported here only as geometric inputs. They are deliberately NOT converted into a total loss: that would require the unknown bend/crossing/interlayer coefficients. The single known parameter is the propagation-loss experiment convention 0.05 dB/cm (not measured).

comparison_r40_vs_r15.note: R40 numbers are the frozen historical routed counts only; every length/geometry/loss column in this R15 report is computed from R15 artefacts. The two rounds are never mixed outside this comparison.
